generationHistory.prompt: Use case: background-extraction and precise-object-edit. Asset type: one EMPTY three-dimensional wicker fruit basket for the LEFT-facing shelf plane of the approved 2D shop hall. Images 1 and 2 are approved camera/material references: match the golden woven produce baskets on the LEFT display shelves. Isolate/create only ONE empty rectangular honey-brown wicker FRUIT BASKET with a clearly deep rear wall and deep side walls, but a deliberately LOW front lip of just TWO or THREE horizontal rows of wicker weaving. Rear wall roughly 7–9 weaving rows tall, about three times the front lip; side walls slope smoothly from the high rear to the low front. Keep an open top, visible empty woven interior bottom, rounded rectangular corners and sturdy rounded woven rim. The volume must read as a real fruit container, with a deep back retaining fruit, while low front allows future upright fruit sprites to be visible. Absolutely no fruit, goods, hands, handles, lid, cloth, shelves, furniture, ground or other objects. Preserve the approved camera axes EXACTLY: the basket's LONG front rim and long rear rim slope UP toward the RIGHT about 25 degrees; the SHORT side/depth edges slope DOWN toward the RIGHT about 20 degrees; all vertical wicker corner edges remain vertical. This is an asymmetric axonometric shelf view, not symmetric isometric plus/minus45, not an overhead flat tray or a front-facing basket. The near long wall is the LOW front lip; the far long wall is the HIGH rear wall. Soft stylized 3D game art, detailed honey wicker matching the approved cabinets, warm sunlight, correct self-shadow inside the basket only. One isolated object on genuine alpha transparency, antialiased clean edges, no glowing halo, floor shadow, checkerboard, text or watermark. Landscape 1536 x 1024 canvas with comfortable transparent padding, whole basket and all walls fully visible; centering is fine. Do not flatten the basket's vertical depth or raise the front rim beyond 2–3 weaving rows.
